n760da5744e.headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange plunges by over  6 pc over rumours of Indian strike near Karachi
n760da5744e.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange plunged over 6% on Thursday, with trading halted for an hour after rumours of escalating Indian military action near Karachi. The rumours were unfounded, though the KSE100 index was among those hit.
n760da5744e.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and its benchmark KSE-100 index reflects major listed Pakistani companies. Geopolitical tensions with India can quickly hit investor sentiment there.
n760da5744e.why_moved: Rumours of escalating Indian military action near Karachi triggered the sell-off and a one-hour trading halt, though the rumours were unfounded.

n2f4c785a17.headline: APA to sell New Mexico Permian assets to Permian Resources for $608m
n2f4c785a17.summary: APA has agreed to sell its New Mexico Permian assets to Permian Resources Corporation for $608 million. The sale is subject to customary closing adjustments.
n2f4c785a17.why: The Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico is a major US oil and gas producing region, and asset deals there shift production and acreage between operators.

n32fd9f6218.headline: Disney+ subs hit 126m in strong Q2 earnings
n32fd9f6218.summary: Disney reported Disney+ subscribers reached 126 million in its second-quarter earnings. The company also announced an Abu Dhabi theme park, with Bob Iger highlighting its content slate.
n32fd9f6218.why: Disney is a major US media and entertainment conglomerate whose streaming subscriber counts and park investments are closely watched by investors.

n9c10a9c0e8.headline: Bank cuts interest rates to 4.25% as tariff tensions dampen growth
n9c10a9c0e8.summary: The central bank cut the UK's base interest rate to 4.25%, following a slowdown in inflation in recent months. The decision comes as tariff tensions weigh on growth.
n9c10a9c0e8.why: The Bank of England sets the UK base rate, which influences borrowing costs, sterling and gilt yields across the economy.
n9c10a9c0e8.why_moved: The central bank cut rates after inflation slowed, while tariff tensions were cited as dampening growth.

n444cd22d6d.headline: Refinery in Schwedt Calls for Oil Embargo Reversal
n444cd22d6d.summary: A refinery in Schwedt, Germany, is calling for a reversal of the oil embargo. The plant's position was reported without further detail on the policy's terms.
n444cd22d6d.why: Schwedt's refinery is a major fuel supplier for eastern Germany, so supply rules for crude feedstock affect regional fuel prices.

nb2a461dcba.headline: Suez Canal Zone deal with UAE sparks public debate, PM clarifies agreement
nb2a461dcba.summary: Egyptian Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly addressed public debate over an agreement between the Suez Canal Economic Zone and Abu Dhabi Ports Group for the KIZAD East Port Said project.
nb2a461dcba.why: Abu Dhabi Ports Group is a major port operator, and port deals in the Suez Canal corridor affect trade routes between Asia, Europe and Africa.

n44add8e7ac.headline: African Development Bank and Dashen Bank sign $40 million trade finance facility to support Ethiopian imports and private sector
n44add8e7ac.summary: The African Development Bank and Dashen Bank have signed a $40 million trade finance facility to support Ethiopian imports and private sector activity.
n44add8e7ac.why: Trade finance lines help importers pay for goods and support private-sector trade, and the AfDB is a multilateral lender focused on African development.

n4e33128f14.headline: Well-known Charlotte startup sells for $2.2 billion
n4e33128f14.summary: AvidXchange, a Charlotte-based company formed in 2000 with over 1,600 employees at the end of last year, is being sold for $2.2 billion.
n4e33128f14.why: AvidXchange provides accounts payable software for businesses, and acquisitions like this reshape valuations in the financial software sector.

nb16a0d4676.headline: Fuel crisis and civilian fears mount as drones continue to strike eastern Sudan
nb16a0d4676.summary: Drone strikes hit the eastern Sudanese cities of Port Sudan and Kassala on Wednesday. The strikes come amid a fuel crisis and rising civilian fears.
nb16a0d4676.why: Port Sudan is Sudan's main seaport, and attacks on fuel supply and logistics affect trade and the wider economy.

n3ebe34972a.headline: RBM holds policy rate amidst marginal inflation rise
n3ebe34972a.summary: The Reserve Bank of Malawi kept its policy rate unchanged, citing a marginal rise in inflation. The headline indicates no change to monetary settings.
n3ebe34972a.why: The central bank's policy rate sets the benchmark for borrowing costs and influences the kwacha and government debt pricing.

n6b11fe6fb9.headline: ExxonMobil to invest $1.5bn in Nigeria's deep-water oilfields
n6b11fe6fb9.summary: ExxonMobil has committed $1.5bn to Nigeria's deep-water oilfields. The investment signals continued commitment to Nigeria's oil and gas sector.
n6b11fe6fb9.why: ExxonMobil is a major US integrated oil company, and its deep-water spending affects Nigerian crude output and oil sector investment.

impacts.name: ExxonMobil
impacts.why: The company is committing $1.5bn of capital to deep-water projects, adding to its upstream spending.

nd4261b5c99.headline: Nigeria clears $3.4bn IMF COVID-19 loan
nd4261b5c99.summary: The IMF has removed Nigeria from its credit outstanding list for May 1 to May 6, 2025. The move follows Nigeria clearing its $3.4bn COVID-19 emergency loan.
nd4261b5c99.why: The IMF credit outstanding list tracks member countries' borrowings from the Fund, signalling their external financing position to creditors.

nd4d136ee2a.headline: Trump promises ‘exciting day’ ahead of announcement on UK-US trade deal
nd4d136ee2a.summary: Donald Trump promised an 'exciting day' ahead of an announcement on a UK-US trade deal, calling it 'very big'. Sir Keir Starmer said he would act in the national interest.
nd4d136ee2a.why: A UK-US trade agreement would set tariff and market-access terms between two major economies, affecting British exporters and sectors such as autos and agriculture.

n69175b3f81.headline: Court affirms MultiChoice's right to raise subscription rates, says FCCPC can't regulate prices
n69175b3f81.summary: A federal high court in Abuja upheld DStv and GOtv subscription rate increases after MultiChoice Nigeria sued the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission. The court ruled the regulator cannot regulate prices.
n69175b3f81.why: MultiChoice, owned by South Africa's Canal+ group, runs the DStv and GOtv pay-TV services, and court rulings on pricing power affect its Nigerian revenue.

n5f767505a6.headline: How Trump's tariffs are causing pain for some U.S. manufacturers
n5f767505a6.summary: Pennsylvania robotics maker Craig Souser expected a surge in business after Donald Trump's election, but tariffs are now causing pain for some US manufacturers, according to the report.
n5f767505a6.why: Tariffs raise input costs for manufacturers that rely on imported components and can reduce demand from customers, affecting margins across US industry.

n69b4fcb3c6.headline: Students at WA’s private colleges would see financial aid slashed under new state budget
n69b4fcb3c6.summary: The state budget plan awaiting Governor Bob Ferguson's signature would cut financial aid for low-income Washington students at private four-year colleges. The reduction would apply to students attending those institutions.
n69b4fcb3c6.why: State budget decisions on student aid affect public spending and the revenue and enrollment outlook of private colleges. These effects matter for education providers and municipal and state finance watchers.

nbe7fb73cbd.headline: Rupee slumps 84 paise to close  at 85.61 against US dollar
nbe7fb73cbd.summary: The rupee closed provisionally at 85.61 against the dollar after falling 84 paise on Thursday. Forex traders cited heightened India-Pakistan geopolitical tensions and risk aversion.
nbe7fb73cbd.why: The rupee's dollar exchange rate affects India's import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets. Geopolitical tensions often push investors toward safer assets.
nbe7fb73cbd.why_moved: Forex traders said investors turned risk-averse amid heightened geopolitical tensions between India and Pakistan, weighing on the rupee.

n85c847e045.headline: Aussie inflation continues to ease
n85c847e045.summary: The ABS Q1 CPI showed trimmed mean inflation fell to 2.9% year-on-year, within the Reserve Bank of Australia's 2% to 3% target band. The data was highlighted by MacroBusiness.
n85c847e045.why: Trimmed mean inflation is the measure the Reserve Bank of Australia weighs most heavily when setting interest rates, so it shapes rate expectations and the Australian dollar.

ne0637a82dc.headline: Equities rise with dollar, bond yields on trade optimism after US-UK deal
ne0637a82dc.summary: Global equities were slightly higher as Wall Street outperformed, while the dollar and Treasury yields gained after the US and UK outlined a trade deal, Reuters reported.
ne0637a82dc.why: Trade agreements between major economies shape tariff levels, supply chains and investor risk appetite across markets.
ne0637a82dc.why_moved: The US-UK trade agreement fueled hopes for compromises with other countries, lifting equities, the dollar and Treasury yields.

neef061f556.headline: Harbour Energy announces 250 job cuts at Aberdeen UK unit
neef061f556.summary: Harbour Energy, the largest oil and gas producer in the British North Sea, has reportedly planned to cut its UK workforce by a quarter, around 250 jobs, citing government policies.
neef061f556.why: Harbour Energy is a major North Sea oil and gas producer, and its operating decisions reflect UK energy policy and tax conditions.

n11a6d45726.headline: Trump keeps 10% tariffs on UK but cuts taxes on British autos, steel and aluminum with trade deal
n11a6d45726.summary: The United States and Britain are expected to announce a trade deal that keeps a 10% tariff on UK goods but lowers the burden on British autos, steel and aluminium.
n11a6d45726.why: Tariffs on autos, steel and aluminium affect the cost and competitiveness of manufacturers and their supply chains across the Atlantic.

n09b4608ee0.headline: What the interest rate cut means if you have a mortgage, loan, or savings
n09b4608ee0.summary: The Bank of England has cut interest rates. Wales Online reports on what the cut means in practical terms for mortgages, loans and savings.
n09b4608ee0.why: The Bank of England sets the UK Bank Rate, which feeds into mortgage, loan and savings pricing across the economy and influences sterling and gilt yields.
n09b4608ee0.why_moved: The Bank of England cut interest rates, a decision that directly changes borrowing and savings costs in the UK.

n5f55e0ca4d.headline: GOP centrists revolt against steep cuts to Medicaid and other programs in Trump's tax breaks bill
n5f55e0ca4d.summary: Some Republican centrists oppose steep Medicaid cuts in Trump's tax and spending bill. Representative Juan Ciscomani said he would not support cuts that could hit thousands of residents in his Arizona district.
n5f55e0ca4d.why: Medicaid is the largest US public health insurance programme, and its funding levels affect hospitals, insurers and state budgets.

nb28892941d.headline: Wellington Airport boosts income but faces festering fleet problems
nb28892941d.summary: Wellington Airport's performance improved, but its chief warned that fleet issues could linger for about a year.
nb28892941d.why: Airports earn revenue from passenger charges and retail, so traffic and operating issues affect their financial results and their airline partners.

nb3fcf15316.headline: Pound, UK stocks take some heart from US/UK trade deal
nb3fcf15316.summary: The pound edged up on Thursday while British stocks struggled to find a foothold after Donald Trump and Keir Starmer unveiled a trade deal.
nb3fcf15316.why: Sterling is the currency of the United Kingdom, and FTSE 100 companies earn much of their revenue abroad, so trade policy affects both.
nb3fcf15316.why_moved: The unveiling of the US-UK trade deal supported the pound, while British equities struggled to gain ground.

n3caa2496bb.headline: Senate takes up crypto bill amid uncertainty
n3caa2496bb.summary: The Senate has taken up crypto legislation, but bipartisan negotiations over a compromise bill have yet to produce a deal. Uncertainty over the bill's final form remains.
n3caa2496bb.why: US crypto legislation determines how digital assets are regulated, which affects exchanges, issuers and token markets.

n4f3273811e.headline: HHRG dismisses CEO over serious misconduct and abuse of authority
n4f3273811e.summary: HHRG Bhd has dismissed its chief executive officer, Fong Chee Khuen, with immediate effect. The company cited serious misconduct and abuse of authority.
n4f3273811e.why: A sudden CEO dismissal raises governance questions and leadership continuity concerns for a listed company's shareholders.

n2c279cfa6c.headline: Trump agrees to cut UK tariffs on autos, steel & aluminum as part of planned trade deal
n2c279cfa6c.summary: Trump said the planned trade deal would fast-track American goods, with the final details being written up. The agreement includes cuts to tariffs on UK autos, steel and aluminium.
n2c279cfa6c.why: Tariffs on autos, steel and aluminium affect manufacturing costs and cross-border trade flows between the US and UK.

n72b033e1df.headline: Ringgit closes slightly lower against US dollar
n72b033e1df.summary: The ringgit closed slightly lower against the US dollar on Thursday, as confidence in the greenback was deemed to have returned, according to an economist.
n72b033e1df.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect import costs, foreign investment flows and regional currency sentiment.

na5fe5ee981.headline: Equities rise with dollar, bond yields on trade optimism after US-UK deal
na5fe5ee981.summary: Global equities were slightly higher on Thursday, with Wall Street outperforming, while the dollar and Treasury yields also gained after the United States and UK reached a trade deal.
na5fe5ee981.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies and is the main benchmark for global equity sentiment, while Treasury yields set the baseline for borrowing costs worldwide.
na5fe5ee981.why_moved: Trade optimism following the US-UK deal lifted equities, the dollar and Treasury yields, as the report describes.

n9bd27136d5.headline: Willis caught between the devil and her deep red sea of debt
n9bd27136d5.summary: The government says it is floating in a sea of red ink, while the Reserve Bank says government debt is low by global standards. An analysis examines whether both can be right.
n9bd27136d5.why: Government debt levels affect fiscal policy, bond yields and the currency, and the central bank's assessment shapes interest-rate expectations.

n48fc6bdd09.headline: What Bank of England's interest rate cut means for your mortgage
n48fc6bdd09.summary: The UK base rate has been reduced from 4.5 percent to 4.25 percent. The cut affects borrowing costs, including mortgage rates for UK households.
n48fc6bdd09.why: The Bank of England sets the UK base rate, which steers borrowing costs, sterling and inflation. Changes feed through to mortgages, savings and the gilt market.
n48fc6bdd09.why_moved: A lower base rate reduces the cost of borrowing in the UK. Lower rates can weigh on sterling and feed into mortgage pricing.

n5cae19b715.headline: Shopify sees second-quarter revenue above estimates, profit view drags shares
n5cae19b715.summary: Shopify forecast second-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates, signaling it was steadily adding sellers. Its profit view weighed on shares despite global trade uncertainty.
n5cae19b715.why: Shopify is a Canadian e-commerce platform that powers online stores for merchants worldwide. Its guidance is watched as a gauge of online retail activity.

impacts.name: Shopify
impacts.why: Shares were dragged lower by the profit view despite the stronger revenue forecast.

n5cae19b715.why_moved: A revenue outlook above estimates was offset by the profit view, which pulled shares down.

na56749be0a.headline: South Korean presidential frontrunner says US risks isolation with tariffs
na56749be0a.summary: South Korea's presidential frontrunner said Seoul should not rush a trade deal with the United States. He called for a coordinated response with other countries to US tariffs.
na56749be0a.why: South Korea is a major exporter of semiconductors, autos and electronics, so US tariff policy directly affects its export sector. Trade negotiations shape its economic outlook.

n0e85e43090.headline: Canada's Cenovus Energy beats Q1 estimates on higher output
n0e85e43090.summary: Cenovus Energy's shares jumped nearly 10% after the Canadian producer posted lower first-quarter profit but beat Wall Street estimates on higher output.
n0e85e43090.why: Cenovus is a major Canadian oil and gas producer whose output and earnings track crude oil and natural gas prices.
n0e85e43090.why_moved: Shares rose after the company beat Wall Street estimates on higher output despite lower first-quarter profit.

n2c57db84ab.headline: Crypto Stocks Jump as Bitcoin Surges Above $100,000 for First Time in Three Months
n2c57db84ab.summary: Bitcoin surpassed $100,000 for the first time since early February. Shares of Strategy and Coinbase and other bitcoin-linked stocks soared on Thursday.
n2c57db84ab.why: Bitcoin's price drives the performance of crypto-exposed companies such as Coinbase, a major crypto exchange, and Strategy, a large bitcoin holder.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The price rose above $100,000 for the first time since early February.

impacts.why: Coinbase shares rose with bitcoin-linked stocks.

n2c57db84ab.why_moved: Bitcoin's price moved above $100,000, and stocks tied to the cryptocurrency rallied in response.

nb0da549cc4.headline: SAP New Zealand posts strong result despite tax hit
nb0da549cc4.summary: SAP's New Zealand business grew strongly in the year to December 2024, with revenue rising from $193.3 million to $217.5 million. The result was achieved despite a tax hit.
nb0da549cc4.why: SAP is a German enterprise software company, and its regional subsidiaries report local results that feed into group performance.

n44cd9be5c9.headline: Amid trade tensions, businesses should look at new growth paths, says DBS CEO
n44cd9be5c9.summary: DBS CEO Tan Su Shan discussed navigating the impact of US tariffs, the bank's first-quarter results and its use of AI. She spoke in an interview with CNA.
n44cd9be5c9.why: DBS is Singapore's largest bank by assets, and its earnings reflect regional trade and lending conditions.

nb6598dae42.headline: Union accepts inevitable as Boliden swings the job axe
nb6598dae42.summary: Boliden Rönnskär has negotiated a new organisational structure for its Skellefteå operations. The structure includes a total of 762 positions, according to Norran.
nb6598dae42.why: Boliden is a Swedish mining and metals company, and its restructuring affects smelting capacity and employment in northern Sweden.

n0bf8c07e6f.headline: Wall Street gains as first trade deal reached
n0bf8c07e6f.summary: US stocks climbed as investors cheered a new trade deal between the US and Britain. President Trump signalled that upcoming talks with China would be more substantial.
n0bf8c07e6f.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies, so trade policy developments with major partners feed directly into broad equity valuations.
n0bf8c07e6f.why_moved: Investors cheered a new trade deal between the US and Britain, and Trump signalled that talks with China would be more substantial.

nad1518ec2d.headline: Land prices in Limerick lag behind three other counties in Munster, new report reveals
nad1518ec2d.summary: A new report shows land prices in Limerick trail three other counties in Munster. A local auctioneer said tariffs are casting a long shadow over the agricultural sector.
nad1518ec2d.why: Farmland values reflect agricultural incomes and trade conditions, and tariffs on farm exports influence those returns in Ireland.

n3f8a0b0b3d.headline: UK secures first Trump 2.0 era trade deal: What it means for financial advisers and their clients
n3f8a0b0b3d.summary: The UK has secured the first trade deal of the Trump 2.0 era, according to IFA Magazine. Ryan's Tom Shave said the deal signals the UK is clearly open to business.
n3f8a0b0b3d.why: Trade agreements between major economies affect tariffs, cross-border investment and sector-level export flows.

na5bb958d8c.headline: Aker Horizons ASA: First-quarter results 2025
na5bb958d8c.summary: Aker Horizons ASA, a developer of green energy and industry, published its first-quarter 2025 results. The company is listed in Oslo under the ticker AKH.
na5bb958d8c.why: Aker Horizons is an Oslo-listed developer of green energy and industrial projects, linked to the wider Aker group.

n99ad4a4d04.headline: LafargeHolcim to install Tk180 crore new mill
n99ad4a4d04.summary: LafargeHolcim Bangladesh will install an industrial mill at its Surma plant in Chhatak, Sunamganj, to improve energy efficiency and reliability, according to an exchange filing.
n99ad4a4d04.why: LafargeHolcim Bangladesh is a listed cement maker whose capital spending on plant upgrades affects its costs and output.

n57c1c69bdc.headline: Photocure ASA: Results for the first quarter of 2025
n57c1c69bdc.summary: Photocure reported Hexvix and Cysview revenues of NOK 125.3 million in the first quarter of 2025, up from NOK 116.8 million a year earlier.
n57c1c69bdc.why: Photocure is a Norwegian medical technology company that sells bladder cancer diagnostic products, and its quarterly revenue tracks demand for them.

n82fb1c0f2a.headline: Siemens Energy expects limited US tariff hit, raises prices for new orders
n82fb1c0f2a.summary: Siemens Energy expects only a limited hit to profits from US tariffs, citing price increases for new orders. The power equipment maker is based in Germany.
n82fb1c0f2a.why: Siemens Energy makes power generation and grid equipment, so tariff costs and pricing shape its margins and its exposure to US demand.

nadc81a6bf8.headline: Report calls for ‘auto pact’ tying duty-free vehicle imports to Canadian production
nadc81a6bf8.summary: A new report suggests Canada negotiate an auto trade deal with the US and Mexico with permanent import tariffs, granting automakers a break if they meet minimum local production requirements.
nadc81a6bf8.why: Auto trade rules between Canada, the US and Mexico shape vehicle production, investment and supply chains across North American carmakers.

nfe47d05476.headline: Ozempic claims another scalp as Weight Watchers hits the wall
nfe47d05476.summary: The behavioural weight-loss market continues to struggle amid the medical weight-loss boom, as Weight Watchers goes bankrupt.
nfe47d05476.why: Weight Watchers, now WW International, is a US commercial weight-management company whose subscription model competes with prescription GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.

n2aff72fe9f.headline: Bloodbath at PSX: KSE-100 closes nearly 6,500 points lower amid Pakistan-India escalation
n2aff72fe9f.summary: The KSE-100 benchmark index shed 6,482.21 points, or 5.89%, at the close amid escalating Pakistan-India tensions.
n2aff72fe9f.why: The KSE-100 is the main benchmark of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, reflecting the country's largest listed companies and investor sentiment.
n2aff72fe9f.why_moved: Escalating Pakistan-India tensions prompted a broad sell-off, with the benchmark index falling sharply in a single session.

nbb298d3330.headline: Bill Gates announces plan to give 'virtually all' his money away and end foundation in 20 years
nbb298d3330.summary: Bill Gates plans to distribute 99% of his wealth, around $200 billion, within 20 years before shuttering the Gates Foundation in 2045.
nbb298d3330.why: Gates is a co-founder of Microsoft, and the Gates Foundation is one of the world's largest private philanthropic bodies, funding global health and development.

n202d3e0d45.headline: STARZ completes its separation from Lionsgate
n202d3e0d45.summary: STARZ has completed its separation from Lionsgate and is trading as a standalone public company on the Nasdaq from Tuesday.
n202d3e0d45.why: Spin-offs create separate listed companies, letting investors value the streaming business independently of its former parent.

n0b12ad053d.headline: Solvay S.A.: Solvay first quarter 2025 results
n0b12ad053d.summary: Solvay S.A. posted solid first-quarter 2025 results, driven by a diversified portfolio and cost-saving measures.
n0b12ad053d.why: Solvay is a major chemical company; its performance signals trends in industrial demand and cost management effectiveness.

impacts.name: Solvay S.A.
impacts.why: Positive earnings supported by diversification and cost savings improve outlook.

n12e19343e0.headline: Truecaller AB: Strong growth of recurring revenues and underlying profit
n12e19343e0.summary: Truecaller, a global platform for contact verification and spam blocking, announced strong growth in recurring revenues and underlying profit for the January-March 2025 quarter.
n12e19343e0.why: Truecaller is a leading technology company in communication services, and its revenue and profit growth reflect demand for digital identity and spam prevention solutions.

nc4e273caca.headline: King Mohammed Invests Millions in Emergency Stockpiles
nc4e273caca.summary: Morocco will invest 7 billion dirhams, nearly 670 million euros, in establishing emergency stockpiles. King Mohammed wants the country better prepared for possible disasters.
nc4e273caca.why: Public spending on strategic reserves affects government budgets and the supply of essential goods during crises. Investors track such spending as part of fiscal policy.
